changes_vs_current: Hannibal Lecter 1st and Wicked Witch/Ratched/Vader/Bates top 5; Joker falls from 2nd to 7th, Vader from 1st to 4th. Added: Harry Powell, Amon Goeth, The Alien, Annie Wilkes, HAL 9000, Cody Jarrett, Alex DeLarge, Alex Forrest, Jack Torrance, Mr. Potter, Travis Bickle, Dracula, Hans Beckert. Dropped: Voldemort, Palpatine, Agent Smith, Terminator, Cruella, Michael Myers, Gollum, Sauron, Ursula, Maleficent, Pennywise, Jaws, Scar.
confidence: low: all three numeric sources are critic or industry panels (AFI 2003 predates Voldemort, Thanos, etc.; the 2016 Empire vote is only 28 people and ranks Vader 33rd), so the result skews classic and obscure (Cody Jarrett, Alex Forrest, Hans Beckert, Travis Bickle is an anti-hero). The two public/industry polls that favor Vader and the Joker (THR 1,000 pros; TheJournal 13,217 votes) were top-5/7-option only, so they are not in the math. Ranker's 129K-voter fan list could not be read (Cloudflare). Recommend a fan-vote source before replacing the live list; Empire 2026 alone would keep Vader, Joker, Gruber, Hannibal, Landa, Chigurh, Thanos, Voldemort at the top.
